title: RevokePrivateLinkServiceAccessRequest
description: Request object for the RevokePrivateLinkServiceAccess method.

cloudAccountId.description: AWS account ID to authorize access for Private Link.

subscriptionId.description: Azure subscription ID to authorize access for Private Link.

region.description: Region where the Private Link service exists.

serviceGroup.description: CDP service group. Currently supports "CDP-CONTROL-PLANE" for PaaS.

cloudServiceProvider.description: Cloud Service Provider. Currently supporting AWS and AZURE.

CloudServiceProvider.description:
Supported cloud providers
 `AWS` - A value indicating AWS as supported cloud provider for creating Private Links. `AZURE` - A value indicating Azure as supported cloud provider for creating Private Links.
